name: Read native spy-capacity sources after two preserved failures

steps.code:
local b=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary,'boundary reader missing')
assert(b.ReadEnemyResultDiagnostic()=='FAILED','turn-45 failed native mission changed')
local owner=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
assert(owner==0 and Players[owner]:IsTurnActive(),'attacker turn changed')
local player=Players[owner]
local culture=player:GetCulture()
local capacity=player:GetDiplomacy():GetSpyCapacity()
local grants={}
for row in GameInfo.CivicModifiers() do
  if row.ModifierId=='CIVIC_GRANT_SPY' then
    local civic=GameInfo.Civics[row.CivicType]
    grants[#grants+1]=row.CivicType..':'..tostring(civic and culture:HasCivic(civic.Index))
  end
end
table.sort(grants)
local candidates={}
for _,kind in ipairs({'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_LOCAL_LEAGUES_AND_INTELLIGENCE','CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_NANBAN_ENVOYS','CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TEA_DIPLOMACY','CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_GUN_CORPS_ORGANIZATION'}) do
  local civic=GameInfo.Civics[kind]
  candidates[#candidates+1]=kind..':'..tostring(civic and culture:HasCivic(civic.Index))
end
return 'turn='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()..' capacity='..tostring(capacity)..' grants='..table.concat(grants,',')..' candidates='..table.concat(candidates,',')
